seo.title: Track Easy — Simple Habit Tracker for iOS
seo.description: Track habits without the hassle. Unlimited habits, streaks, calendar view, widgets, and Apple Watch support. No accounts, no subscriptions.

hero.label: HABIT TRACKER
hero.title: Track habits without the hassle.
text: Build better habits with a tracker that respects your time. No sign-up, no subscriptions, no data collection. Just you and your habits.

items.title: Unlimited Habits
items.text: Create as many habits as you want. Pick custom icons and colors from a beautiful palette. No limits, no premium tier.

items.title: Streak Tracking
items.text: Stay motivated with current and personal-best streaks. A flame icon shows when you're on fire. Don't break the chain.

items.title: Calendar View
items.text: Review your history with a monthly calendar. Color-coded completions create a visual heat map of your progress.

items.title: Home Screen Widgets
items.text: Check off habits right from your home screen. Small, medium, and lock screen widgets keep habits front and center.

items.title: Apple Watch
items.text: Track habits from your wrist. See today's habits and tap to complete. Simple and fast.

items.title: Statistics
items.text: Understand your habits with charts. See completion rates, weekly trends, and your best-performing habits.

sections.label: PRIVACY
sections.title: Your habits stay yours.
text: No analytics. No ads. No tracking. No cloud sync. Your habit data lives on your device and nowhere else. Zero data collection, period.

cta.title: Start building habits.
cta.text: Free on the App Store. No account required.
